sourceOfTruth: SE-ARCH-DEPLOY-001 V1.0 CURRENT + D10 ThingsBoard deployment adjudication
name: Phase 1 availability tier and single-node upgrade path

tiers.availabilityClaim: No numeric availability claim until measured. RPO/RTO are recovery objectives, not HA guarantees.
Component-level redundancy for measured availability. Does not make the whole platform HA.
Numeric SLO may be declared only with multi-node topology evidence and measured error budget.

spofInventory.currentProtection: continuous WAL archive + daily base backup; no streaming standby
spofInventory.businessImpact: Platform-wide outage: registry, IAM, telemetry current state, scheduler, outbox, commands and audit are unavailable
upgradePath: Add a streaming standby with synchronous_commit policy chosen by the RPO requirement
Add automatic failover (Patroni/repmgr or managed PostgreSQL) with fencing of the old primary
Make application DSNs failover-aware and prove switchover with a real drill
Publish replication lag, failover and backup readiness metrics
spofInventory.trigger: Required availability exceeds measured single-node availability, or the accepted data-loss window is smaller than achievable PITR.

spofInventory.currentProtection: daily native backup; raw telemetry remains rebuildable from PostgreSQL history relay and Edge replay
spofInventory.businessImpact: History and analytics queries degrade; telemetry ingestion continues and Edge Store and Forward protects the source data
upgradePath: Prefer rebuild-from-authority for phase 1: keep ClickHouse as a rebuildable projection
Before ClickHouse HA, change MergeTree objects to ReplicatedMergeTree/ReplicatedAggregatingMergeTree under ClickHouse Keeper
Add a versioned rebuild-and-verify procedure that proves row counts and watermarks after restore
Only then add a second replica and query routing policy
spofInventory.trigger: History/analytics query availability becomes a hard business requirement and rebuild time exceeds its RTO.

spofInventory.currentProtection: single volatile Redis; Latest projections are rebuildable, while OIDC correlation, realtime recovery and limit buckets are short-lived coordination state; appendonly is disabled
spofInventory.businessImpact: Realtime transport, in-flight OIDC login and fail-closed limit-policy requests can be affected; durable business authority remains outside Redis
upgradePath: Keep durable business authority outside Redis and preserve logical DB/prefix separation between projections and coordination state
Measure whether OIDC/realtime/limit availability justifies a dedicated redundant Redis plane
Then choose Redis Sentinel, managed Redis HA or workload-specific separation based on measured failure impact
Do not claim HA while a request correctness path still depends on a single Redis instance
spofInventory.trigger: OIDC/realtime/limit-policy availability exceeds acceptable single-instance degradation.

spofInventory.currentProtection: Mosquitto TLS persistence; Edge Store and Forward keeps data but not command reachability during outage
spofInventory.businessImpact: Edge telemetry ingress and cloud command egress are unavailable
upgradePath: Publish a stable broker endpoint that supports failover without Edge credential rotation
Evaluate a clustered broker (for example EMQX OSS) or Mosquitto bridging with shared PKI/ACL source
Prove Edge reconnect and replay behavior in a broker failover drill before claiming command-path availability
spofInventory.trigger: Command reachability or telemetry ingress needs component-level redundancy.

spofInventory.currentProtection: stateless node over shared Redis; clients can recover with the bounded recovery contract
spofInventory.businessImpact: Browser realtime delivery is degraded; snapshots and history queries remain available
upgradePath: Run multiple Centrifugo nodes behind the existing Nginx dynamic resolver
Keep history/recovery authority in Redis and Telemetry Runtime, not in a single node
Prove reconnect and recovery success in a node-kill drill
spofInventory.trigger: Realtime delivery requires process-level redundancy before the data plane is made HA.

spofInventory.currentProtection: single compose profiles; logs are rotated on host
spofInventory.businessImpact: Business services continue to run, but alerting and incident diagnosis are lost exactly when they are most needed
upgradePath: Keep observability single-instance in phase 1
Add an independent dead-man switch or external check path for page-critical alerts
Only scale observability after the business services it observes
spofInventory.trigger: Compliance or operational requirements demand an independent alerting path.

reference.adoptedPattern: One artifact selects monolith or service role via service.type; the queue backend is selected separately via queue.type. HVAC Web adopts the topology-switch pattern but keeps PostgreSQL Outbox/Job leases as the durable backbone.

stages.name: Single-server compose
capabilities: PostgreSQL durable Outbox/Inbox and Job leases

stages.name: Toggle embedded owners to independent service containers
capabilities: ENERGY_API_EMBEDDED_OWNERS selects the remaining in-process roles
existing Go owner binaries run in the owner-split Compose overlay
Notification remains the only embedded owner until it has an independently reviewed artifact

stages.name: Scale stateless owners and PostgreSQL-claimed workers
capabilities: multiple telemetry/metric workers using SKIP LOCKED leases
scheduler and outbox relays run multiple owners

stages.name: Data-plane redundancy by component
capabilities: Redis workload availability evidence before Redis HA
MQTT failover after Edge reconnect proof
exitEvidence: component failover drills with measured RPO/RTO
application SLO remains valid during failover

sloScopingRules: A numeric availability SLO on a single-node deployment must state that it is conditioned on infrastructure availability unless measured end to end.
s2 release-gate snapshotHttp.availabilityPercent applies only to COMPONENT_REDUNDANT and HA, is conditional on required infrastructure, and cannot be cited as a whole-platform 99.9% claim.
RPO/RTO attainment requires a timestamped restore drill with real external backup artifacts; container startup is not completion.
No stage in monolithToMultiInstancePath may be claimed as certified without its exitEvidence.
